items.exampleEn: The kitchen counters are made from an antibacterial material.
items.exampleZh: 這些廚房流理台是用抗菌材質做的。

items.exampleEn: In the old novel, the hero's neurosis makes him afraid of open spaces.
items.exampleZh: 在那本老小說裡，主角的精神官能症讓他害怕開闊的地方。

items.exampleEn: The addicted game player forgot to eat lunch again.
items.exampleZh: 那個打電玩上癮的玩家又忘了吃午餐。

items.exampleEn: Diphtheria mostly affects the throat and nose.
items.exampleZh: 白喉主要影響喉嚨和鼻子。

items.exampleEn: Typhoid is caused by a type of germ that lives in dirty water and food.
items.exampleZh: 傷寒是由一種生存在髒水和食物中的病菌引起的。

items.exampleEn: He trained for two years to become a professional masseur.
items.exampleZh: 他受訓了兩年，才成為專業按摩師。

items.exampleEn: Some anticancer drugs work by stopping cells from dividing.
items.exampleZh: 有些抗癌藥物的作用是阻止細胞分裂。

items.exampleEn: The airline made all of its flights non-smoking many years ago.
items.exampleZh: 那家航空公司多年前就讓所有航班全面禁菸。

items.sentenceEn: I'd like a non-smoking table near the window, please.
items.sentenceZh: 麻煩給我一張靠窗的非吸菸區座位。

items.audioEn: The hotel masseur is available from two to six; you can book at the front desk.
items.audioZh: 飯店的按摩師下午兩點到六點有空，可以到櫃台預約。

items.sentenceEn: My little brother is addicted to building model ships.
items.sentenceZh: 我弟弟迷上了做模型船。

items.sentenceEn: This hand soap is antibacterial and smells like lemon.
items.sentenceZh: 這款洗手乳有抗菌效果，聞起來有檸檬味。

items.stemEn: Thanks to vaccines, ____ and other childhood diseases are now rare in many countries.
items.stemZh: 多虧了疫苗，白喉和其他兒童疾病在許多國家都已很少見。

items.stemEn: Doctors often use two or more ____ drugs at the same time.
items.stemZh: 醫生常常同時使用兩種以上的抗癌藥物。

items.passageEn: Our class visited a small museum about the history of medicine. The first room explained how clean water helped end typhoid in many cities. The next showed old posters encouraging parents to protect their children against diphtheria. One display described how Freud and other doctors began to study neurosis. In a modern section, we learned that scientists search the rainforest for plants with anticancer properties. There was also a funny old photo of a small cottage with a sign saying it was the town's first non-smoking hotel. At the gift shop, my friend bought antibacterial hand cream, and I admitted I was already addicted to the museum's audio guides.
items.passageZh: 我們班參觀了一間關於醫學史的小博物館。第一間展示乾淨的水如何幫助許多城市消滅傷寒。下一間展出舊海報，鼓勵家長保護孩子免受白喉侵害。有一個展區介紹佛洛伊德和其他醫生如何開始研究精神官能症。在現代展區，我們學到科學家會在雨林中尋找具有抗癌特性的植物。還有一張有趣的老照片，是一間小屋掛著「本鎮第一家禁菸旅館」的招牌。在紀念品店，朋友買了抗菌護手霜，我則承認自己已經迷上了博物館的語音導覽。

questions.questionZh: 什麼幫助許多城市消滅了傷寒？
科學家為什麼到雨林中尋找植物？
options: 尋找可以做菜用的新香料
